subject: Dragonlord
text: The Dragonlord resides within his dark castle of Charlock.

evidence.quote: Many Brave warriors tried to recover the balls of light, but none of them ever...returned from Charlock, the Dragonlord's dark castle.

subject: Dragonlord
text: The hero's quest is to find and defeat the evil Dragonlord.

evidence.quote: Your quest is to find and defeat the evil Dragonlord.

subject: Control Pad
text: The Control Pad moves the warrior around and navigates menus.

evidence.quote: Control Pad = Moves the warrior around, helps select in menus

subject: B Button
text: Pressing the B button cancels all menus.

evidence.quote: B = Cancels all Menus

subject: A Button
text: Pressing the A button selects commands, performs attacks, and picks up items.

evidence.quote: A = Chooses all the commands in the game. The most used button.

subject: Hit Points
text: When Hit Points fall to zero, the hero dies and reappears at the castle with the king.

evidence.quote: When your Hit Points reach 0, you DIE! YOU DIE! You no...longer breath, and you wind up back at the castle were the king is.

subject: Metal Slime
text: Metal Slimes award the highest amount of experience in the game.

evidence.quote: Metal Slimes give the most EXP in the...game.

subject: Search
text: The Search command inspects the current tile for any items.

evidence.quote: Search = Searches the square that you're currently on for any items.

subject: Door
text: Opening locked doors requires possessing a magic key.

evidence.quote: Some doors may be...locked. This will require you to have a magic key in your possession.

subject: Take
text: The Take command takes items from a treasure chest.

evidence.quote: Take = Allows you to take stuff from a treasure chest.

subject: Spell
text: The player cannot cast spells until reaching at least level 3.

evidence.quote: You won't be able to use this command until you're at least level 3.

subject: Run
text: Successfully fleeing about 4 or more times in a row allows monsters to strike first and blocks further escapes.

evidence.quote: Also, if you manage to run away enough times. A monster...will be prompted to strike you first in a battle, and you won't...be able to run away. This happens after you successfully run away...about 4 or more times in a row.

subject: Swamp
text: Each step taken through poisonous swamps causes the hero to lose two hit points.

evidence.quote: Swamps -  Poisonous Swamps. For each step you take you lose two hits points.

subject: Erdrick's Armor
text: Equipping Erdrick's Armor allows walking across poisonous swamps without taking damage.

evidence.quote: When...you get the Erdrick armor, you can walk right over these damn things...without taking damage, which is good.

subject: Bridge
text: Monsters grow tougher each time the hero crosses a bridge.

evidence.quote: Bridge -  Every time you cross a bridge, the monsters get tougher, so you...better level up.

subject: Craggy Mountains
text: Craggy Mountains are impassable terrain that cannot be crossed anywhere in the game.

evidence.quote: Craggy Mountains - Very, Very steep mountains. They are impassable. You can't...get past them once in the whole game.

subject: Critical Hit
text: A critical hit occasionally lands, dealing over 2X the damage of a regular attack.

evidence.quote: Occasionally you'll deal a critical hit, doing over 2X damage of a regular hit

subject: Death
text: Dying cuts held gold in half and returns the hero to the king's feet.

evidence.quote: If you happen to die, your gold will...be cut in half, and you'll reappear at the king's feet.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Princess Gwaelin is the king's daughter who has been kidnapped.

evidence.quote: Princess Gwalin, the daughter of...the king that's been kidnapped.

subject: Monster
text: Reaching a high enough level causes weaker monsters to run away before combat begins.

evidence.quote: Once you get to a certain level, weaker monsters will start to run away...from you before you can attack.

subject: Dragon Scale
text: Equipping and selling the Dragon Scale retains its +2 defense bonus while clearing inventory space.

evidence.quote: You can buy the Dragon Scale, then take it off and sell it. You'll keep the...+2 defense and you'll have another spot in your bag for items.
